conclusion: External catalogues confirm full spatial coverage of both fixed crops and QA context by Sentinel-2 tile 36UXB on relative orbit R064 across all 7 original pair dates. Copernicus products use baseline 05.00 with -1000 DN radiometric offset (incompatible with frozen reader without offset support; 4.68 GiB for 7 scenes). AWS Earth Search retains original baseline 02.06 matching local data, but distributes COG assets requiring assembly. No download, raster read, QA model, or label was executed; pairs remain blocked.
